Priya Shah: quick thread to lock scope for the 'Optimize Tooling' pilot — we have 6 weeks. Need decisions on must-have features: batching recs, cache TTL guidance, quantization playbook, and eval-triggered alerts. Inputs?

Martin O'Connor: My take: must-haves = per-route batching recs (with estimated cost delta), cache TTL suggestions for common prefixes, and exportable JSON config. Eval alerts can be webhook-only. Auto-quant infra is out of scope.

Devon Brooks: Ops constraint: keep telemetry window to 14 days initially. Recommend simulator that predicts latency impact using sampled traces. Without that recommendations will be too risky.

Anika Bose: Customer-facing ask: simple rollback instructions and a "why this was suggested" sentence. CS wants installable snippets for Node + Python SDKs. Also two pilot customers: HealthCo and StudyAI.

Priya Shah: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) recommender outputs ranked recs with confidence and cost estimate; 2) JSON export + SDK example; 3) eval-alert webhook posts to Slack channel + offer PD integration toggle; 4) docs + pilot onboarding guide.

Martin O'Connor: For ranking metrics use: expected cost % change, expected p95 delta, and eval-simulated quality delta. Keep UI simple table view.

Devon Brooks: Canary plan: support traffic-split tag so customers can apply recs to 2% of traffic. Add hard guardrail: if p95 or eval quality worsens by > 2% revert automatically.

Anika Bose: I'll reach out to HealthCo & StudyAI today. Will prepare two eval sets: chat/dialog and long generation. Also will draft the quickstart snippets.

Priya Shah: Timelines: recommender POC (2 sprints), export+SDK (0.5 sprint), simulator + eval hook (1 sprint). We can parallelize SDK and outreach.

task-bot: Created board card OPT-3421 with subtasks: recommender-poc, simulator, sdk-snippets, eval-webhook, pilot-runbooks. Link: https://projects.internal/OPT-3421

Martin O'Connor: Risk note: batching may increase tail latency; capture p99 in reports and show cost vs tail tradeoff. Also include a small paragraph on quantization safety—why we aren't automating it yet.

Priya Shah: Locked: MVP = suggestions + export + eval webhooks + docs + 2 pilots. Auto-apply and quant automation deferred. If anyone objects speak now, otherwise I'll publish sprint brief.

Devon Brooks: LGTM.

Anika Bose: +1, will send pilot invites.
